def process(topThreeIdTheftReports) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = topThreeIdTheftReports.copy()

    # In this table, credit card fraud corresponds to Theft Type == 'Credit Card'
    cc = df[df['Theft Type'].astype(str).str.strip().eq('Credit Card')]

    reports_2020 = float(cc.loc[cc['Year'] == 2020, '# of Reports'].iloc[0])
    reports_2024 = float(cc.loc[cc['Year'] == 2024, '# of Reports'].iloc[0])

    ratio = reports_2024 / reports_2020

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        'reports_2024': reports_2024,
        'reports_2020': reports_2020,
        'ratio': round(ratio, 4)
    }])

          df = df.rename(columns={

          # Keep only true data rows where Year is a 4-digit year

          )
      
          return df
